name: furnace-idle
comment: WP-1.8 BlockFurnace without fuel. Stone neighbours are set at t=0, furnaces at t=1 (set_block): BlockContainer.onBlockAdded makes a TileEntityFurnace, then setDefaultDirection picks the facing (metadata) from the opaque neighbours: (0,61,0) stone at +z -> 2; (3,61,0) stone at +x -> 4; (-3,61,0) stone at -x -> 5; (0,61,3) none -> 3; (3,61,3) stone at +z and +x -> 4 (x decides last); a lit furnace (62) at (-3,61,3) between two stones on x -> 3 (block light 13). Every tick the tile entities update (TileEntityFurnace.updateEntity: nothing to burn, the lit one stays lit: no updateFurnaceBlockState). t=4: (3,61,0) broken with set_block air (BlockFurnace.onBlockRemoval, empty: no furnaceRand draw). t=5: a stone set next to (0,61,3) does not turn it (no onNeighborBlockChange).
